purpose: Reject an invalid coordinator assignment
preconditions: A club creation or leadership-change operation is being performed
The selected coordinator is not a valid student
Other required assignments are valid
action_or_input: Submit the operation with the invalid coordinator.
expected_result: The operation is rejected or stopped.

purpose: Reject an invalid co-coordinator assignment
preconditions: A club creation or leadership-change operation is being performed
The selected co-coordinator is not a valid student
Other required assignments are valid
action_or_input: Submit the operation with the invalid co-coordinator.
expected_result: The operation is rejected or stopped.

purpose: Reject an invalid replacement leader
preconditions: A leadership-change operation is being performed
At least one proposed replacement leader is not a valid student
expected_result: The operation is rejected or stopped.

purpose: Reject an invalid Club Faculty Councillor
preconditions: Club creation or an event faculty-context operation is being performed
The selected faculty member is invalid
action_or_input: Submit the operation with the invalid faculty member.
expected_result: The operation is rejected or stopped.

purpose: Accept only the specified club categories
preconditions: Club creation is being performed
The selected category is Technical, Sports, or Cultural
action_or_input: Submit club creation once for each specified category.
expected_result: Each specified category is accepted.

purpose: Reject a category outside the specified set
preconditions: Club creation is being performed
The selected category is not Technical, Sports, or Cultural
action_or_input: Submit club creation with the unsupported category.
expected_result: The category is not accepted.

purpose: Enforce the club confirmation lifecycle
preconditions: Valid club data is available
A Student Admin can create and approve the club
action_or_input: Create the club, observe its status, then approve it as Student Admin.
expected_result: Creation results in open status and successful approval changes open status to confirmed.

purpose: Accept a booking whose start precedes its end
preconditions: A session or event booking is being submitted
Start time is earlier than end time
expected_result: The booking satisfies the valid time-range rule.

purpose: Reject equal start and end times
preconditions: A session or event booking is being submitted
Start time equals end time
expected_result: The booking is rejected.

purpose: Reject a booking whose start follows its end
preconditions: A session or event booking is being submitted
Start time is later than end time
expected_result: The booking is rejected.

purpose: Reject overlapping sessions
preconditions: An existing session occupies a venue on a date
A new session overlaps it in the same venue and date
expected_result: The overlapping booking is rejected.

purpose: Reject overlapping events
preconditions: An existing event occupies a venue on a date
A new event overlaps it in the same venue and date
expected_result: The overlapping booking is rejected.

purpose: Reject session-event overlap
preconditions: An existing session or event occupies a venue on a date
A new booking of the other type overlaps it in the same venue and date
expected_result: The overlapping booking is rejected.

purpose: Allow membership application only for a confirmed club
preconditions: A student is applying for membership
The selected club is confirmed
expected_result: The application is permitted by this rule.

purpose: Reject membership application for a non-confirmed club
preconditions: A student is applying for membership
The selected club is not confirmed
expected_result: The application is not permitted.

purpose: Allow applications to multiple different clubs
preconditions: A student has an application or membership in one club
A different club is selected for a new application
action_or_input: Submit the application to the different club.
expected_result: The application is not blocked solely because of the application or membership in the other club.

purpose: Reject a duplicate same-club application
preconditions: A student already has an application for the selected club
action_or_input: Submit another application for the same student and club.
expected_result: The duplicate is rejected and membership state remains unchanged.

purpose: Allow the applicable coordinator or co-coordinator to perform Club Head operation
preconditions: A Club Head operation is being invoked
The actor is the applicable club coordinator or co-coordinator for that club
expected_result: The actor is authorized by this rule.

purpose: Reject a Club Head operation by another actor
preconditions: A Club Head operation is being invoked
The actor is neither the applicable coordinator nor co-coordinator for that club
expected_result: The actor is not authorized by this rule.

purpose: Transition an open application to confirmed on approval
preconditions: An open club-membership application exists
The applicable Club Head approves it
action_or_input: Approve the application and optionally provide remarks.
expected_result: The application changes from open to confirmed and optional remarks are retained.

purpose: Accept a poll with at least two choices
preconditions: Poll creation is being submitted
At least two choices are supplied
expected_result: The poll satisfies the minimum-choice rule.

purpose: Reject a poll with fewer than two choices
preconditions: Poll creation is being submitted
Fewer than two choices are supplied
expected_result: The poll is not created.

purpose: Use selected batch-and-branch groups for poll audience
preconditions: A poll is being created with selected batch-and-branch groups
Students exist both inside and outside the selected groups
expected_result: The intended audience is determined only from the selected groups and is used for notification/access.

purpose: Respect a configured all-branches selection
preconditions: A poll target branch selection represents all branches where that option is supported
action_or_input: Create or access the poll using that configured selection.
expected_result: The selected audience represents all branches for the selected batch.

purpose: Allow eligible participation in an active unexpired poll
preconditions: A poll is active and unexpired
The student belongs to the selected target audience
action_or_input: Request poll details or submit a vote.
expected_result: Participation is allowed by this rule.

purpose: Reject participation when audience or active-poll eligibility fails
preconditions: The poll is expired or inactive, or the student is outside the selected audience
action_or_input: Request poll details or submit a vote.
expected_result: Participation is not allowed.

purpose: Allow a student’s first vote in a poll
preconditions: A student is eligible for an active poll
The student has not already voted in that poll
expected_result: The vote is accepted.

purpose: Reject a second vote by the same student in the same poll
preconditions: A student has already voted in a poll
action_or_input: Submit another vote in the same poll.
expected_result: The second vote is rejected.

purpose: Retire superseded active leadership assignments
preconditions: A club has current coordinator and co-coordinator assignments
A successful leadership change is being performed
action_or_input: Change the coordinator and co-coordinator assignments.
expected_result: New current leaders are recorded and superseded active assignments no longer remain current.

purpose: Accept a zero or positive budget amount
preconditions: A club budget request is being submitted
The amount is zero or greater
expected_result: The amount satisfies the non-negative rule.

purpose: Reject a negative budget amount
preconditions: A club budget request is being submitted
The amount is negative
expected_result: The request is rejected.

purpose: Accept a budget request with its required supporting file
preconditions: A club budget request is being submitted
The required supporting file is present
expected_result: The request satisfies the supporting-file rule.

purpose: Reject a budget request without its required supporting file
preconditions: A club budget request is being submitted
The required supporting file is missing
expected_result: The request is rejected.

purpose: Accept an event report with its required report file
preconditions: An event report is being submitted
The required report/details file is present
expected_result: The report satisfies the required-file rule.

purpose: Reject an event report without its required report file
preconditions: An event report is being submitted
The required report/details file is missing
expected_result: The report submission is rejected.

purpose: Accept booking in a configured venue
preconditions: A session or event booking is being submitted
The selected venue is configured for Gymkhana booking
expected_result: The venue satisfies the configured-venue rule.

purpose: Reject booking in an unconfigured venue
preconditions: A session or event booking is being submitted
The selected venue is not configured for Gymkhana booking
expected_result: The booking is rejected.

purpose: Allow assigned councillor to review assigned-club reports
preconditions: A submitted report exists
The authenticated faculty member is the assigned Club Faculty Councillor for that club
expected_result: Access is allowed for the assigned club.

purpose: Reject access by a councillor not assigned to the club
preconditions: A submitted report exists
The authenticated faculty member is not assigned as councillor for that club
expected_result: Access is denied and no report review access is allowed.
